pretreatment: partially etched in a diluted HF solution and then annealed at a moderate temperature (250 °C) in the UHV preparation chamber
evidence: Prior to the ALD growth of HfO2, the Si(001) sample was partially etched in a diluted HF solution and then introduced into the fast entry of the equipment. The immersion time (30 s) and HF solution (0.25%) have been chosen in order to avoid a complete etching of the oxide and to maintain a certain thickness of the SiO2. The etched sample was then annealed at a moderate temperature (250 °C) in the UHV preparation chamber. That annealing has no effect on the nature and the thickness of the Si-oxide but may remove the hydrocarbon contaminations present on the surface.
